props.gloss_en: Beit Shammai: [the candle blessing is] 'Who created the light of fire'
Beit Hillel: [the candle blessing is] 'Who creates the lights of fire'
over 'bara' everyone agrees that it means 'created'
Rava: where they disagree is over 'borei'
Beit Shammai hold that 'borei' means He will create in the future
Beit Hillel hold that 'borei' too means 'created'
'Who forms light and creates [borei] darkness' (Isa 45:7), 'Who forms mountains and creates [borei] wind' (Amos 4:13), 'Who creates [borei] the heavens and stretches them out' (Isa 42:5)
Rav Yosef: where they disagree is over 'light' and 'lights'
Beit Shammai hold that there is one light in fire
Beit Hillel hold that there are many lights in fire
a baraita: Beit Hillel said to Beit Shammai -- there are many lights in fire
